gancho: Llegó a su cita… y ya había alguien en su lugar
estilo: Cinematic Mexican telenovela look, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, emotional close-ups, realistic people, natural Mexican Spanish acting
escenas: Cozy café with plants and natural light. ANDRÉS (30, short brown hair, navy blazer) sits at a small table. VALERIA (28, curly brown hair, yellow dress) arrives smiling and touches his shoulder: "Perdón la tardanza, amor. ¿Me extrañaste?" Andrés looks confused.

Same café. ANDRÉS (30, short brown hair, navy blazer) looks at VALERIA (28, curly brown hair, yellow dress), then the camera pans to the next table where an identical WOMAN (28, curly brown hair, same yellow dress) sips coffee and waves. Andrés, pale: "Pero… si llevas media hora sentada ahí."

Same café. The twin WOMAN (28, curly brown hair, yellow dress) stands and faces her identical sister VALERIA (curly brown hair, yellow dress) while ANDRÉS (navy blazer) sinks into his chair. The twin smiles: "Hola, hermanita. Ya conocí a tu novio… y me pidió matrimonio." Dramatic zoom on Valeria.
caption: Gemelas, un novio y una propuesta equivocada 👯‍♀️ ¿Quién tiene la culpa? #novela #drama #historiascortas #telenovela #giro
